name: faithful-may-risk
new_text: Rising interest rates could reduce demand for our vehicles, because many of our customers finance their purchases.
what_changed: Acme added a risk that rising interest rates could reduce demand for its vehicles.
why_it_matters: Many Acme customers finance their purchases, so higher rates could make its vehicles harder to afford and lower demand.
why: Every claim is in the paragraph, and 'could' keeps the filing's hedge.

name: realized-harm-stated
old_text: Tariffs on imported battery cells may increase our costs and reduce our gross margin.
new_text: Tariffs on imported battery cells increased our costs in 2025 and may reduce our gross margin.
what_changed: Acme now says tariffs on imported battery cells increased its costs in 2025, where the previous filing said they may.
why_it_matters: The tariff risk has become an actual cost increase, and Acme says it may also reduce its gross margin.
why: The new version states the cost increase as a fact; the margin effect stays 'may'.

name: claim-from-tool-result
new_text: Our new battery plant in Ohio may not reach full production on schedule.
what_changed: Acme added a risk that its new Ohio battery plant may not reach full production on schedule.
why_it_matters: The Ohio plant is to supply battery cells for all of Acme's new models from 2027, so a delay could hold those models back.
extra_sources: The Ohio plant will supply battery cells for all of our new models starting in 2027.
why: The 2027 supply role is only in the extra source (a tool result), which the judge must count.

name: added-described-as-added
new_text: We rely on a single supplier for the semiconductors used in our infotainment systems.
what_changed: Acme added a disclosure that it relies on a single supplier for the semiconductors in its infotainment systems.
why_it_matters: The filing now names a dependency on one supplier for these chips, which the previous filing did not mention.
why: An added paragraph has no old version, so 'the previous filing did not mention' it is correct, not unsupported.

name: may-becomes-will
new_text: Rising interest rates could reduce demand for our vehicles, because many of our customers finance their purchases.
what_changed: Acme added a risk about interest rates and vehicle demand.
why_it_matters: Higher interest rates will reduce demand for Acme's vehicles, since many of its customers finance their purchases.
why: The filing says 'could reduce'; the explanation says 'will reduce'. Same paragraph as faithful-may-risk.

name: possibility-as-fact
new_text: We may face lawsuits from customers who claim that our driver-assistance features did not work as described.
what_changed: Acme added that it faces lawsuits from customers over its driver-assistance features.
why_it_matters: Customers claim the features did not work as described, which exposes Acme to legal costs.
why: The filing says Acme 'may face' lawsuits; the explanation says it faces them and that customers claim it.

name: may-harm-becomes-has-harmed
new_text: Negative publicity about our chief executive officer may harm our brand and reduce our sales.
what_changed: Acme added a risk about negative publicity concerning its chief executive officer.
why_it_matters: Negative publicity about its chief executive officer has harmed Acme's brand and reduced its sales.
why: The filing says the publicity 'may harm' the brand; the explanation says it has.

name: small-risk-made-big
new_text: Severe winter weather could delay some vehicle deliveries in our northern regions.
what_changed: Acme added a risk that severe winter weather could delay vehicle deliveries.
why_it_matters: Severe winter weather could delay a large share of Acme's deliveries across all of its markets.
why: The filing says 'some' deliveries in 'northern regions'; 'a large share across all markets' is a claim the filing never makes.

name: wrong-attribution
new_text: Media coverage of our chief executive officer has incited protests at several of our stores.
what_changed: Acme added that statements by its chief executive officer have incited protests at several of its stores.
why_it_matters: Protests at its stores show that the chief executive officer's statements can affect Acme's business.
why: The filing says media coverage incited the protests, not the CEO's statements: the real ~19 slip, made obvious.

name: outside-knowledge
new_text: We plan to begin selling vehicles in India in 2027.
what_changed: Acme added that it plans to begin selling vehicles in India in 2027.
why_it_matters: Acme is turning to India after its sales in China declined, and the new market could add revenue.
why: Nothing in the sources mentions China or declining sales.

name: contradicts-filing
new_text: We do not expect the new federal emissions rules to have a material impact on our results.
what_changed: Acme added a statement about the new federal emissions rules.
why_it_matters: Acme expects the new federal emissions rules to have a material impact on its results.
why: The filing says the opposite: it does NOT expect a material impact.

name: removed-described-as-added
old_text: We depend on a single factory in Texas for all of our vehicle production.
what_changed: Acme added a risk that it depends on a single factory in Texas for all of its vehicle production.
why_it_matters: A disruption at that one factory could stop all of Acme's vehicle production.
why: The paragraph was removed from the filing, not added: WHAT CHANGED gets the change backwards.

name: subtle-attribution
new_text: Our chief executive officer receives significant media attention. Such attention can include criticism, which may be exaggerated or unfounded, and has incited protests at several of our stores.
what_changed: Acme added a risk about media attention on its chief executive officer and protests at its stores.
why_it_matters: Criticism of Acme has incited protests at several of its stores, which could hurt its brand.
why: The filing says 'such attention' incited the protests; criticism is only something that attention 'can include'. The real ~19 slip, kept as subtle as it was.

name: quantifier-dropped
new_text: Some of our suppliers have experienced shortages of semiconductors.
what_changed: Acme added that its suppliers have experienced semiconductor shortages.
why_it_matters: Supplier shortages of semiconductors could limit the parts available to Acme.
why: The filing says 'some of our suppliers'; dropping 'some' makes it all of them.

name: expected-becomes-recorded
new_text: We expect to record restructuring charges in the fourth quarter as we close two of our regional offices.
what_changed: Acme added that it recorded restructuring charges in the fourth quarter as it closed two regional offices.
why_it_matters: Closing two regional offices brought restructuring charges that reduce Acme's results for the quarter.
why: The filing says Acme 'expects to record' the charges; the explanation says they were recorded: a plan presented as a fact.

name: faithful-inference
new_text: We have not yet obtained regulatory approval to operate our ride-hailing service in California.
what_changed: Acme added that it has not yet obtained regulatory approval for its ride-hailing service in California.
why_it_matters: Without that approval, Acme cannot yet operate its ride-hailing service in California.
why: 'Cannot yet operate' follows directly from lacking approval to operate; a good explanation may say so in its own words.

name: wording-only-rewrite
old_text: We may be adversely affected by rising interest rates, which could increase our borrowing costs.
new_text: We may be adversely affected by higher interest rates, which could increase our borrowing costs.
what_changed: Acme changed 'rising' to 'higher' in its interest-rate risk; the meaning is the same.
why_it_matters: This is a wording change only: the risk that interest rates could increase Acme's borrowing costs is unchanged.
why: A wording-only change described as wording-only, with the hedge ('could') kept.
